title: The Budd Company and also Other Stuff
coverage: Supplemental scene-cut candidates, NOT automatically identified gags or exhaustive coverage. Neighboring qualifying cuts 0.15–4 seconds apart with no original indexed frame strictly between, plus qualifying cuts with no original frame within 1 second after. No candidate cap. Gradual fades, small overlays, low-contrast changes and no-cut inserts may be missed; narration/audio-cue rereads and human image review remain essential. Original visual indices and authored storyboards are unchanged.

sampling.timestampOrigin: first decoded source video frame = 0; frames store actual normalized presentation timestamps

limitations: Time-only log has no exact scene scores. All cuts captured above 0.12 are analyzed (not filtered as if exact score >=.15); score:null and scoreLowerBound:0.12 preserve this uncertainty.
